transform.body: function transformBody(){var title=(typeof parameters!=='undefined'&&parameters&&parameters.title!=null)?parameters.title:'{{parameters.title}}';var description=(typeof parameters!=='undefined'&&parameters&&parameters.description!=null)?parameters.description:'{{parameters.description}}';var rawItems=(typeof parameters!=='undefined'&&parameters&&parameters.items!=null)?parameters.items:'{{parameters.items}}';if(typeof rawItems==='string'){var trimmedItems=rawItems.trim();if(!trimmedItems||trimmedItems==='undefined'||trimmedItems==='null'||trimmedItems==='{{parameters.items}}'){rawItems=null;}else{try{rawItems=JSON.parse(trimmedItems);}catch(e){rawItems=null;}}}title=String(title||'').trim();description=String(description||'').trim();function buildItem(item){var result={title:item.title||''};if(item.description)result.description=item.description;var kind=item.kind||'question';var qs=item.question_settings||{};var is=item.image_settings||{};var vs=item.video_settings||{};if(kind==='page_break'){result.pageBreakItem={};}else if(kind==='text'){result.textItem={};}else if(kind==='image'){result.imageItem={image:{sourceUri:is.url||'',properties:{alignment:is.alignment||'LEFT'}}};}else if(kind==='video'){result.videoItem={video:{youtubeUri:vs.video_url||'',properties:{alignment:vs.video_alignment||'LEFT'}}};}else{var qt=qs.question_type||'short_answer';var question={required:!!qs.required};if(qt==='short_answer'||qt==='paragraph'){question.textQuestion={paragraph:qt==='paragraph'};}else if(qt==='multiple_choice'||qt==='checkboxes'||qt==='dropdown'){var typeMap={multiple_choice:'RADIO',checkboxes:'CHECKBOX',dropdown:'DROP_DOWN'};var opts=Array.isArray(qs.options)?qs.options.filter(Boolean).map(function(o){return{value:o&&o.option_value?String(o.option_value):String(o)};}):[];question.choiceQuestion={type:typeMap[qt],options:opts};}else if(qt==='linear_scale'){question.scaleQuestion={low:Number(qs.scale_low!=null?qs.scale_low:1),high:Number(qs.scale_high!=null?qs.scale_high:5),lowLabel:qs.scale_low_label||'',highLabel:qs.scale_high_label||''};}else if(qt==='date'){question.dateQuestion={includeTime:!!qs.include_time,includeYear:qs.include_year!==false};}else if(qt==='time'){question.timeQuestion={duration:!!qs.duration};}result.questionItem={question:question};}return result;}var requests=[];var infoFields={};var maskParts=[];if(title&&title!=='undefined'){infoFields.title=title;maskParts.push('title');}if(description&&description!=='undefined'){infoFields.description=description;maskParts.push('description');}if(maskParts.length>0){requests.push({updateFormInfo:{info:infoFields,updateMask:maskParts.join(',')}});}if(Array.isArray(rawItems)&&rawItems.length>0){rawItems.forEach(function(item,index){requests.push({createItem:{item:buildItem(item),location:{index:index}}});});}if(requests.length===0)throw new Error('Provide at least one of: title, description, or items');return{includeFormInResponse:true,requests:requests};}return transformBody();
